name: oikos-card-starter
description: Template + tooling per creare card community per la dashboard Oikos.

scripts.build:my: node tools/build-card.mjs cards/my-card && node tools/pack-card.mjs cards/my-card
scripts.build:all: for d in cards/*/; do case "$d" in cards/_*) continue;; esac; [ -d "${d}src" ] && node tools/build-card.mjs "$d"; done && node tools/generate-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:examples: for d in examples/*/; do node tools/build-card.mjs "$d"; done
